mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown in both consumer demand and manufacturing output, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a monthly increase in the consumer price index signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction and reduced consumer confidence, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decreases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which typically precedes a recession and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (industrial production growth below 0.5% year-over-year), a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a worsening supply shock that disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO YoY < 0.5%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
